title: Aoyagi Toya — Feelings That Were Buried〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This place looks like a mess...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does...
Wait! Toya, stop!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
There's a hole there so watch out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, good eye. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is supposed to be that fragment's SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But this place looks like it's falling apart. It almost hurts just looking at it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. Fragments of feelings aren't usually supposed to be dangerous in any way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But this floor doesn't look safe.
It may not be wise to go any further.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I have a feeling there's something up ahead...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I can't describe it...
But it's like it wants to be found...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku.
I can't help but wonder. I'm going to take a quick look.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: T-Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are those...? A piano and a violin?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's covered in dust, but it doesn't look broken in any way. It might still be playable if I clean it up a little.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The piano and violin still mean a lot to you, right, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem relieved that the piano and violin didn't fall through the floor. Am I right in saying that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be the case...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What do you mean by that?
You need to learn to embrace your feelings more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right and wrong are just words.
Have you asked yourself what you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize. I was under the impression that I'd been doing just that lately thanks to everyone around me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I seem to get confused when it comes to classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Or rather... I'm avoiding it subconsciously because a part of me doesn't want to think about it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Avoiding it...?
Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because things were easier back then if I did that...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No. Again.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Again.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: But my fingers...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No. Again. Until you get it right.

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I used to admire the way my dad plays the piano...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He has this way of taking all of the music theory he knows and combining it with everything he's experienced to produce this magnificent sound that perfectly reflects a composer's thought process...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There was a time when I dreamed of being able to do the same thing someday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wanted to practice and work hard to meet my parents' expectations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I had to suffer for it and was never allowed to say what was on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see... I have a better understanding of why you were putting your feelings at arm's length.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Admitting that as being true would've caused your motivation to crumble to pieces, so it was easier to just never think about it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In retrospect, that may be what I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ultimately, I wasn't able to keep fooling myself and ran away from classical music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wouldn't say that you “ran away”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I understand that you wanted to make your parents proud but couldn't meet their expectations...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But isn't it about time you let all that go and forgive yourself?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, your partner being such a stoic person might not have helped...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm hoping that you'll take this opportunity to see yourself in a more positive light.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: More positive...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For example, as opposed to saying, “Classical music is all I have...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You could say, “I will always have classical music.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd even go as far as adding, “I like classical music and respect my dad very much.” Especially since you've already faced up to him and your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really don't think it needs to be more difficult than that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let me ask you this again, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The piano and violin still mean a lot to you, right, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The piano and violin are both...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're back.
How do you feel, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did we have to leave that piano and violin all alone there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... It's a SEKAI born from a fragment of a feeling, so it'll be up to that feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you hope will happen to them, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I hope...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking that far ahead.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, that may be a good place for you to start.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
You've opened my eyes quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome, but I'm also glad that I got to know you a little better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you still have some time until practice. How about we stop by MEIKO's place for a quick break?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
